records.title: Simulating Unified Tensor Resharding in heterogeneous AI systems
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed: State-of-the-art AI training simulators assume homogeneous compute and network infrastructure. However, real-world training infrastructure is becoming increasingly heterogeneous since: (a) Model architectures such as multimodal and MoE exploit heterogeneity to improve device utilization, (b) Public cloud platforms often provide limited availability of homogeneous hardware due to fast hardware evolution, and (c) Large… Out of scope: Distributed LLM training simulator, not inference infrastructure.

records.title: NebulaExp-8B: An Empirical Post-Training Pipeline via Full-Scale Ablation Research
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed: Post-training alignment determines the reasoning and human preference following capabilities of large language models, yet most existing works withhold detailed data construction, filtering rules and training recipes, which hinders community reproducibility and lightweight model optimization. This work presents NebulaExp, a fully transparent, ablation-driven post-training pipeline built on Qwen3-8B-base, covering two… Out of scope: Post-training alignment pipeline and data recipe.

records.reason: The reported speedups are promising but confined to one target model and non-public workloads without production serving-latency comparisons.

records.title: EGG: An Expert-Guided Agent Framework for Kernel Generation
records.reason: The kernel optimization is relevant as an enabling runtime technique, but the paper does not establish end-to-end LLM serving performance and averages over general kernel tasks.
